# no-cache.net

> > Technical documentation and projects covering HTTP caching directives and automotive microcontroller modifications

no-cache.net provides detailed explanations of web caching protocols, particularly the HTTP Cache-Control header and no-cache directive, alongside DIY technical projects including automotive electronics modifications for vehicles like Mazda.

## Key Topics

- HTTP Cache-Control
- no-cache directive
- HTTP headers
- caching directives
- HTTP caching
- Mazda i-stop
- OBDII
- automotive modification
- microcontroller projects
- relay circuits
- engine auto-stop
- emission systems

## HTTP Caching Documentation

- [Cache directive "no-cache" | An explaination of the HTTP Cache-Control header](https://no-cache.net/): Explains HTTP Cache-Control header and no-cache directive

## Automotive & Hardware Projects

- [How to disable the Mazda i-stop system](https://no-cache.net/projects/mazda-how-to-disable-istop/): DIY guide for disabling Mazda i-stop engine auto-stop using OBDII
